title: Parse a positive integer into a variant
prompt: Implement `std::variant<int, std::string> parse_positive(const std::string& s)`. On success (a syntactically valid integer literal greater than 0, fitting int) return the value; otherwise return the error string `"invalid: <s>"`. An optional leading `+` is allowed; `-5`, `abc`, an empty string, and 0 are invalid. Overflow beyond INT_MAX is invalid.

tests.name: negative
tests.hint: Negatives are not positive — the error string includes the input.

tests.name: zero-and-garbage
tests.hint: 0 fails the positivity rule; mixed chars fail syntax.
